newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Two dead, two missing after Belgian cafe attack.
newsitem.headline: Two dead, two missing after Belgian cafe attack.

text.p: Two people died on Monday and two others were missing after a petrol bomb attack on a Brussels cafe, the Belga news agency said.
It said the building collapsed after a fire caused by the attack.
A Reuter correspondent at the scene said the building was completely gutted .
Belgian BRTN radio said four suspects had been arrested. The motives for the attack were unclear.

Police declined to give details, but Belga said the device went off at around 0300 GMT in the six-storey building in the Brussels commune of Molenbeek. Neighbours had heard the sound of breaking glass and screeching car tyres shortly before the blaze.

The two victims found were men, aged 46 and 37. A mother of 33 and her four children were saved just in time, Belga said. The room they were in caught fire 30 seconds after they had been rescued by ladder.
BRTN said the cafe was empty at the time of the attack. It said there had been problems with drugs and gambling in the cafe, which was also used for political meetings.
